blockade.prompt: Equirectangular 360 panorama of open outer space, the view from a ship floating in the void: only stars and nebula in every direction, above and below. A vast luminous emission nebula in neon magenta and violet with electric cyan filaments and dark dust lanes, dense fields of sharp pinpoint stars, a few bright blue-white star clusters. Mostly deep black space. Retro synthwave palette, high contrast, astrophotography detail.
